cards.title: Apple Launches Health Study App with AI
cards.body: Apple released a new app designed to study how people use AI for everyday medical questions. The app will gather real-world usage data on AI's role in health decision-making.

cards.title: Bharat Semi Raises $24M for AI Sensors
cards.body: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi secured $24M in seed funding to scale AI-enabled sensor technology. The company has already locked design wins with General Atomics and others.

cards.title: ChatGPT Wallet Enables AI Shopping Agent
cards.body: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, allowing AI agents to shop and checkout on users' behalf. The limited rollout started with U.S. Pro subscribers.

cards.title: LangChain Reaches $3B Valuation
cards.body: AI agent startup LangChain hit a $3B valuation with 7,000 customers using its LangSmith platform. The tool provides model and platform-agnostic agent management.

cards.title: ElevenLabs Launches AI Meeting Notetaker
cards.body: ElevenLabs released ElevenAI, a new meeting notetaker and dictation app for teams. The product targets enterprises seeking automated meeting documentation.

cards.title: Muse AI Places Business Calls for Fee
cards.body: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses through a paid service. The feature expands Muse's commercial automation capabilities.

cards.title: Nebius Plans $40B AI Infrastructure Expansion
cards.body: Nebius announced plans to spend $40 billion on AI infrastructure, funded through customer prepayments and loans. The neocloud model aims to scale compute capacity globally.

cards.title: China's Advanced AI Models Use Banned Chips
cards.body: New research reveals China's most powerful AI models were trained on export-banned Nvidia chips. The finding raises U.S. national security concerns in the AI race.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following a personal scandal involving affairs with company executives. The departure creates uncertainty for Nvidia's leadership and AI industry funding.

cards.title: Tech Execs Petition to Reinstate Huang
cards.body: Elon Musk and other tech executives launched a petition calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement. The petition surpassed 115,000 signatures by Saturday.

cards.title: Huang's Exit Threatens AI Startup Funding
cards.body: VCs and founders warn that Nvidia's funding for AI startups may shrink without Jensen Huang. Smaller checks and lower valuations are expected.

cards.title: Democrats Launch Nvidia Investigation
cards.body: Congressional Democrats opened a second investigation into Nvidia, focusing on China sales and Trump dealings. The probe follows allegations of Huang's espionage-related affair.

cards.title: Silicon Valley's Failed Midterm Predictions
cards.body: Tech leaders like Sam Altman and Elon Musk claim to predict the future, yet Silicon Valley spectacularly miscalculated the midterm elections. This blind spot raises questions about whether AI visionaries truly understand society's trajectory.

cards.title: Brain Implants Give Volunteers More Autonomy
cards.body: Brain implant trials have enabled people to control robotic limbs and computers through decoded neural activity. Volunteers now demand greater autonomy and fewer NDAs in exchange for their crucial participation in AI research.

cards.title: Nvidia Confirms Chip Tracking Technology Feasible
cards.body: Nvidia privately told lawmakers it can technically implement anti-smuggling chip-tracking measures, contradicting public industry claims of infeasibility. The revelation exposes a gap between what's technically possible and what the industry claims publicly.

cards.title: FAA Expands AI for Air Traffic Management
cards.body: The FAA is rolling out AI-powered advice across US airspace to manage congestion more efficiently. This marks a significant step in automating air traffic control decisions nationwide.

cards.title: OpenAI Board Warns of Imminent AI Takeover
cards.body: An OpenAI board member expressed concern that an AI "takeover" of society could occur within months. The warning underscores growing anxiety about rapid AI advancement outpacing safety measures.
